text_en: Josiah was eight years old when he began to reign; he reigned thirty-one years in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 约史雅登极时才八岁，在耶路撒冷作王凡三十一年。

text_en: He did what was right in the sight of the Lord , and walked in the ways of his ancestor David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
text_cn: 他行了上主视为正义的事，走了他祖先达味所走的路，不偏左，也不偏右。

text_en: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was still a boy, he began to seek the God of his ancestor David, and in the twelfth year he began to purge Judah and Jerusalem of the high places, the sacred poles, and the carved and the cast images.
text_cn: 他在位第八年，虽然年幼，就已开始寻求他祖先达味的天主；在位第十二年，就已开始清洁犹大和耶路撒冷，除去高丘、木偶、雕像和铸像。

text_en: In his presence they pulled down the altars of the Baals; he demolished the incense altars that stood above them. He broke down the sacred poles and the carved and the cast images; he made dust of them and scattered it over the graves of those who had sacrificed to them.
text_cn: 他看着人把巴耳的丘坛拆毁，他亲自打碎丘坛上的香炉，将木偶、雕像和铸像打碎，磨成粉末，撒在祭祀偶像的人的坟上；

text_en: He also burned the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Judah and Jerusalem.
text_cn: 在祭坛上焚烧了邪神司祭的骨骸，这样洁净了犹大和耶路撒冷。

text_en: In the towns of Manasseh, Ephraim, and Simeon, and as far as Naphtali, in their ruins all around,
text_cn: 他在默纳协、厄弗辣因、西默盎、以迄纳斐塔里各城和其周围四郊，也行了同样的事：

text_en: he broke down the altars, beat the sacred poles and the images into powder, and demolished all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel. Then he returned to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 拆毁丘坛，将木偶和雕像打碎，将以色列全境内所有的太阳柱都砍倒；然后回了耶路撒冷。

text_en: In the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan son of Azaliah, Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah son of Joahaz, the recorder, to repair the house of the Lord his God.
text_cn: 约史雅在位第十八年，进行清洁各地和圣殿时，派阿匝里雅的儿子沙番，城尉玛阿色雅和约阿哈次的儿子约阿黑御史，去修理他的天主上主的圣殿。

text_en: They came to the high priest Hilkiah and delivered the money that had been brought into the house of God, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had collected from Manasseh and Ephraim and from all the remnant of Israel and from all Judah and Benjamin and from the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
text_cn: 他们便去见大司祭希耳克雅，将献于天主殿宇的银钱当面交给他。这些银钱是守门的肋未人，由默纳协、厄弗辣因和以色列全体遗民，以及犹大、本雅明和耶路撒冷居民那里收来的。

text_en: They delivered it to the workers who had the oversight of the house of the Lord , and the workers who were working in the house of the Lord gave it for repairing and restoring the house.
text_cn: 他们再转交给监督上主殿内工作的人，这些人发给在上主殿内工作和修理殿宇的人，

text_en: They gave it to the carpenters and the builders to buy quarried stone, and timber for binders, and beams for the buildings that the kings of Judah had let go to ruin.
text_cn: 即发给木匠和泥水匠，或购买凿好的石头和作木架及栋梁的木料，来修理历代犹大王失修的建筑。

text_en: The people did the work faithfully. Over them were appointed the Levites Jahath and Obadiah, of the sons of Merari, along with Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to have oversight. Other Levites, all skillful with instruments of music,
text_cn: 这些工人都勤于操作，监管他们工作的监督是默辣黎族的肋未人雅哈特与敖巴狄雅，和刻哈特族的则加黎雅与默叔蓝；尚有精于乐器的肋未人，

text_en: were over the burden bearers and directed all who did work in every kind of service; and some of the Levites were scribes, and officials, and gatekeepers.
text_cn: 兼管搬运的人，督促做各种工作的人。肋未人中还有些书记，作职员，作门丁的。

text_en: While they were bringing out the money that had been brought into the house of the Lord , the priest Hilkiah found the book of the law of the Lord given through Moses.
text_cn: 人们将献于上主殿宇的银钱拿出来的时候，大司祭希耳克雅发现了上主藉梅瑟所颁布的法律书。

text_en: Hilkiah said to the secretary Shaphan, “I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord ”; and Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.
text_cn: 希耳克雅告诉书记沙番说：“我在上主殿内发现了法律书。”遂将书交给了沙番。

text_en: Shaphan brought the book to the king, and further reported to the king, “All that was committed to your servants they are doing.
text_cn: 沙番带着那卷书去见君王，向君王回报说；“凡陛下命你仆人所办的事，都已照办了。

text_en: They have emptied out the money that was found in the house of the Lord and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and the workers. ”
text_cn: 已将上主殿内所有的银钱倒出来，交在监督和工人的手里了。”

text_en: The secretary Shaphan informed the king, “The priest Hilkiah has given me a book. ” Shaphan then read it aloud to the king.
text_cn: 书记沙番继而向君王报告说：“大司祭希耳克雅还交给我一卷书。”沙番就在君王面前朗诵了那书。

text_en: When the king heard the words of the law he tore his clothes.
text_cn: 君王一听了法律上的话，就撕裂了自己的衣服，

text_en: Then the king commanded Hilkiah, Ahikam son of Shaphan, Abdon son of Micah, the secretary Shaphan, and the king’s servant Asaiah:
text_cn: 立即吩咐希耳克雅、沙番的儿子阿希甘、米加的儿子阿贝冬、书记沙番和君王的臣仆阿撒雅说：

text_en: “Go, inquire of the Lord for me and for those who are left in Israel and in Judah, concerning the words of the book that has been found; for the wrath of the Lord that is poured out on us is great, because our ancestors did not keep the word of the Lord , to act in accordance with all that is written in this book. ”
text_cn: 你们快去为我，为以色列的遗民和犹大，询问上主关于所发现的这书上的话，因为我们的祖先没有遵守上主的话，未照这书上所记载的去行，所以上主才向我们大发愤怒。”

text_en: So Hilkiah and those whom the king had sent went to the prophet Huldah, the wife of Shallum son of Tokhath son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe (who lived in Jerusalem in the Second Quarter) and spoke to her to that effect.
text_cn: 希耳克雅和君王所派的人，去见胡耳达女先知，她是掌管礼服的沙隆的妻子──沙隆是哈色辣的孙子，提刻瓦的儿子。胡耳达住在耶路撒冷新区；他们对她说明来意，

text_en: She declared to them, “Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Tell the man who sent you to me,
text_cn: 她就回答他们说：“上主以色列的天主这样说：你们回报那派你们来见我的人说：

text_en: Thus says the Lord : I will indeed bring disaster upon this place and upon its inhabitants, all the curses that are written in the book that was read before the king of Judah.
text_cn: 上主这样说：我必要使在犹大王前所读的书中记载的灾祸和一切诅咒，降在这地和这地上的居民身上，

text_en: Because they have forsaken me and have made offerings to other gods, so that they have provoked me to anger with all the works of their hands, my wrath will be poured out on this place and will not be quenched.
text_cn: 因为他们舍弃了我，向别的神焚香；他们所做的，无不惹我动怒，所以我的怒火要向这地方发作，总不熄灭。

text_en: But as to the king of Judah, who sent you to inquire of the Lord , thus shall you say to him: Thus says the Lord , the God of Israel: Regarding the words that you have heard,
text_cn: 至于那派你们来求问上主的犹大王，你们要这样对他说：上主以色列的天主这样说：因为你听了这些话，

text_en: because your heart was penitent and you humbled yourself before God when you heard his words against this place and its inhabitants, and you have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes and wept before me, I also have heard you, says the Lord .
text_cn: 因为你一听了我指着这地和这地上的居民所说的话，你的心就已感化，在上主前自卑自贱，撕裂了你的衣服，在我面前痛哭，我也应允了你：上主的断语。

text_en: I will gather you to your ancestors and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace; your eyes shall not see all the disaster that I will bring on this place and its inhabitants. ” They took the message back to the king.
text_cn: 我要使你与你祖先团聚，你要安归你的坟墓；你的眼睛见不到我在这地上和这些居民身上要降的灾祸。”他们回去，将她说的话报告给君王。

text_en: Then the king sent word and gathered together all the elders of Judah and Jerusalem.
text_cn: 君王于是派人召集犹大和耶路撒冷所有的长老来；

text_en: The king went up to the house of the Lord , with all the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the priests and the Levites, all the people both great and small; he read in their hearing all the words of the book of the covenant that had been found in the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 君王同所有的犹大人，耶路撒冷的居民、司祭、肋未人、全体人民，不分贵贱，都上到上主的殿内，在上主殿内，将寻获的约书上的一切话，读给他们听。

text_en: The king stood in his place and made a covenant before the Lord , to follow the Lord , keeping his commandments, his decrees, and his statutes, with all his heart and all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
text_cn: 君王站在高台上，在上主面前立约，要全心全意服从上主，遵守他的诫命，他的典章和他的法律，履行这书上所载的盟约的话；

text_en: Then he made all who were present in Jerusalem and in Benjamin pledge themselves to it. And the inhabitants of Jerusalem acted according to the covenant of God, the God of their ancestors.
text_cn: 他使所有在耶路撒冷的人都接受这盟约。于是耶路撒冷的居民都按照上主，他们祖先天主的盟约而行。

text_en: Josiah took away all the abominations from all the territory that belonged to the people of Israel, and made all who were in Israel worship the Lord their God. All his days they did not turn away from following the Lord the God of their ancestors.
text_cn: 约史雅将以色列子民各地的一切可耻之物除去，使所有在以色列的人， 都奉事上主他们的天主。约史雅王在世时，他们从未离弃上主，他们祖先的天主。
